window-frame.intent: warm wooden frame behind the tending figure

window-glass.intent: quiet pale daylight within the wooden frame

window-upright.intent: one upright divides the daylight panes

window-crossbar.intent: one crossbar divides the quiet panes

sill.intent: a broad wooden sill supports the plant

gardener.intent: a gentle blue-haired gardener looks toward the plant

neck.intent: short skin bridge from chin into the shirt

shirt.intent: soft coral shirt cropped below the waist

resting-sleeve.intent: the relaxed sleeve descends out of the crop

reaching-sleeve.intent: one sleeve reaches right toward the watering can

can-body.intent: a golden watering vessel hangs below the hand

spout.intent: a long tapered spout points above the plant

water.intent: a thin blue stream should land in the pot

plant-pot.intent: a blue planter rests on the right end of the sill

plant-stem.intent: one upright stem emerges from the planter

leaf-1.intent: a broad left leaf opens from the stem

leaf-2.intent: a broad right leaf opens from the stem

leaf-3.intent: a broad left leaf opens from the stem

leaf-4.intent: a broad right leaf opens from the stem

soil.intent: a dark oval opening explains soil and the landing of the watering stream

carrying-hand.intent: a compact closed hand holds the actual top segment of the can handle

handle-left.intent: the left handle leg follows both the hand and vessel

handle-right.intent: the right handle leg follows both the hand and vessel

can-opening.intent: a dark oval interior makes the watering vessel opening explicit

scope: editable gesture strokes and colour masses, flat cartoon heads, front-view open hands, compact illustrative grips with an owned handle segment, planar locks and scenic recipes; no full 3D head/hand rig or whole-artwork acceptance claim

alignment_legend.blue: pinned stroke endpoints / inspected target; removal: retained affected children
alignment_legend.green rings: named mount points or protected endpoints/knuckle
alignment_legend.white target: local edge/spine, terminal, digit-tip or exact-mount focus

move_units: object: shorter canvas dimension; local edge: nominal lock width; shape contour: nominal shorter extent; stroke spine: thickness; stroke terminal: shorter canvas; digit tip: nominal digit span
